scripts/extract-real-ground-truth.mjs: Rewrites the PR-review ground truth from public bug-fix commits, so running it inside a pull request would replace the dataset the pull request is being judged against. It needs the GitHub API and a judge model, and its output is committed deliberately. Local tool: run it when the dataset changes, not on every push.
scripts/measure-candidate.mjs: A developer's question — which tests name this file, and what do they say its coverage is — answered on demand for one path. It measures nothing on its own and borrows the run that is already happening, so a CI invocation would produce a figure about the file the workflow happened to be editing.
scripts/generate-comparison-report.ts: Runs the full CA-Bench industry comparison and writes docs/INDUSTRY_COMPARISON.md plus the dashboard. It is a document generator, not a check: wiring it today would either commit on every push or leave the document silently stale. Recorded in the roadmap as a generated-and-compared step, with the comparison and not the generation being the thing a gate can assert.
scripts/run-llm-bench.ts: A standalone DeepSeek review-quality benchmark needing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. The same protocol is scored inside the repository by the evaluation protocol scorers and by the Martian harness, both of which run in workflows and publish artifacts; this entry point exists for a single run against a candidate model, which is a person's decision rather than a nightly job.
